title: fix(cache): key the parsed diff by head rather than by number
author: hubot
body:
The dashboard re-parsed every diff on every refresh, so a queue of eighty rows spent most of a second in the parser.

Keying the cache by head commit means a pull request nobody pushed to is parsed once. A force-push invalidates its own entry, which is what the old key could not express.

<details><summary>the numbers, on this laptop</summary>

| rows | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| 80 | 940ms | 60ms |
</details>

comments.author: github-actions
comments.body: **Coverage** 84.2% (+0.4%). No file dropped below the 70% floor.
